name: Full System Health Snapshot
description: Kernel version, uptime/load average, memory usage, and disk space summary.

name: Top CPU & Memory Offenders
description: Lists the top CPU and memory consuming processes currently running.

name: Recent System & Service Errors
description: Pulls recent error/warning entries from system logs and server.log.

name: Find Largest Files & Folders
description: Scans current working directory for disk usage by file and folder.

name: Inspect & Clean Temp Workspace
description: Lists workspace files and verifies writable storage status.

name: Quick Timestamped Backup Archive
description: Creates a backups directory and archives configuration & log files.
command: mkdir backups && tar -czf backups/config_snapshot.tar.gz app_config.json welcome.txt && ls -la backups

name: Listening Ports & Active Sockets
description: Shows open TCP listening ports and bound server processes.

name: Network Interface & DNS Check
description: Checks active network interfaces, routing, and loopback connectivity.

name: TLS / Config Endpoint Audit
description: Inspects application TLS and port configuration in app_config.json.

name: Active SSH Users & Recent Logins
description: Shows currently logged-in sessions, recent logins, and auth events.

name: SSH Key & Permissions Audit
description: Audits directory permissions and checks for exposed credential files.

name: World-Writable & Config Integrity Check
description: Scans workspace files and prints recent security warnings from server.log.

name: Docker Container & Resource Status
description: Lists running containers and resource utilization snapshot.

name: Failed Systemd Services Check
description: Checks service manager health and lists any degraded units.

name: Git Repo Status & Recent Commits
description: Displays current branch status and latest commit history.
